name: manual_16f1df
claim: Opaque topology fields do not sanitize the rest of a payload: redact complete known branch tokens and withhold residual legacy labels in every nested value and mapping key before derived recall or export.

decisions.notes: PT481 regressions exposed bare branch/ref tokens and labels outside topology fields, including paths outside the home<local-tmp-dir> regex; raw history is preserved.
